headline: House resolution would have ordered the House Ethics Committee to publicly release its report on former Representative Matt Gaetz.
what_it_does: This resolution would have directed the House Committee on Ethics to make public its report on its investigation into allegations against former Representative Matt Gaetz. The House voted on December 5, 2024, to table it or send it back to committee, so it did not pass. No official summary is available, so further details are not known.

who_it_affects.how: The committee would have been required to release its investigation report to the public.
The committee's findings about allegations against him would have been made public.
People would have been able to read the committee's report on the investigation.
